```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(mnet)
library(dplyr)
library(mlVAR)
library(tidyverse)

name = "v1_day"
model = "lme"
step = 'transformed' #######step options: imputed, transformed, pca


# stayed_depressed: 
  # 1 = People who stayed not-depressed from baseline to end
  # 2 = People who stayed depressed from baseline to end
  # missing = people who changed category from baseline to end


brighten_dir = "/Users/klj9278/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Kaley_research_NYU/EMA_projects/smartphone_sensor_modelling_may26/data/interim"
output_dir =  "/Users/klj9278/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Kaley_research_NYU/EMA_projects/smartphone_sensor_modelling_may26/results/charts/mlVAR/trainval"

features <- list(
  v1_day = list(anova = c("aggregate_communication","mobility","mobility_radius",
                          "sms_length","sms_count","missed_interactions",
                          "call_count","call_duration", "interaction_diversity", "phq2_1","phq2_2"), 
                lme = c("interaction_diversity","call_count","unreturned_calls","mobility",
                        "mobility_radius","sms_count","missed_interactions","call_duration", "phq2_1","phq2_2")
                ),
                
  v1_week = list(anova = c("aggregate_communication","mobility","mobility_radius",
                          "sms_length","sms_count","unreturned_calls","missed_interactions",
                          "call_count","call_duration", "interaction_diversity", "phq2_1","phq2_2","phq9_sum"), 
                lme = c("interaction_diversity","call_count","unreturned_calls","mobility",
                        "mobility_radius","sms_count","missed_interactions","call_duration",
                        "phq2_1","phq2_2","phq9_sum")
                )
)

cols = features[[name]][[model]]
path <- file.path(brighten_dir, paste0(name, "_trainval_", step, "_outcomes.csv"))
df <- read.csv(path)
df <- df[!is.na(df$stayed_depressed), ] #drop missing values, people who changed over time.
table(df$stayed_depressed)

df_cols = df %>% select(num_id,stayed_depressed, all_of(cols))





```


```{r checking-v1day}

# Check values
# Check for infinite values
sapply(df[, cols], function(x) sum(is.infinite(x)))

# Check for NaN
sapply(df[, cols], function(x) sum(is.nan(x)))

# Check for NA
sapply(df[, cols], function(x) sum(is.na(x)))


# Check for zero-variance columns within a person
# If a person never varies on a variable, regression fails
#zero_var = df %>%
 # group_by(num_id) %>%
  #summarise(across(all_of(cols), sd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  #summarise(across(all_of(cols), function(x) sum(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  #filter(if_all(all_of(cols), function(x) x < 0.5)) %>%
  #pull(num_id)

# Check NA rate per person per variable
perc_missing_mobility = df %>%
  group_by(num_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mob_na = sum(is.na(mobility)),
    mob_n  = n(),
    mob_pct = mob_na / mob_n
  ) %>%
  filter(mob_pct > 0.5) %>%
  arrange(desc(mob_pct))

# Check NA rate per person per variable
perc_missing_mobility_r = df %>%
  group_by(num_id) %>%
  summarise(
    mobr_na = sum(is.na(mobility_radius)),
    mobr_n  = n(),
    mobr_pct = mobr_na / mobr_n
  ) %>%
  filter(mobr_pct > 0.5) %>%
  arrange(desc(mobr_pct))


# Check NA rate per person per variable
perc_missing_calls = df %>%
  group_by(num_id) %>%
  summarise(
    uc_na = sum(is.na(unreturned_calls)),
    uc_n  = n(),
    uc_pct = uc_na / uc_n
  ) %>%
  filter(uc_pct > 0.5) %>%
  arrange(desc(uc_pct))




# Check NA rate per person per variable
# Remove persons with >50% NA on any variable
nonNA_ids <- df %>%
  group_by(num_id) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cols), function(x) mean(is.na(x)))) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(cols), function(x) x < 0.7)) %>%
  pull(num_id)


#std_results %>%
#  pivot_longer(-num_id, names_to = "column", values_to = "sd") %>%
#  filter(sd == 0 | is.na(sd)) %>%
#  select(num_id, column)

# Find zero-var columns (all std values are 0 or NA)
#zero_var_cols <- std_results %>%
#  select(-num_id) %>%
#  summarise(across(everything(), ~ all(. == 0 | is.na(.)))) %>%
#  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
#  filter(value == TRUE) %>%
#  pull(name)

# print(zero_var_cols)



# Drop participants with a var >50% missing and report number dropped
df_clean <- df_cols %>% filter(num_id %in% nonNA_ids)
cat(n_distinct(df_clean$num_id), "participants. Removed", n_distinct(df$num_id) - n_distinct(df_clean$num_id), "for having a var with >50% NaN. .\n")

# Drop participants with a var with 0 variation and report number dropped

# cat(n_distinct(df_clean$num_id), "participants. Removed", n_distinct(df$num_id) - n_distinct(df_clean$num_id), "for having zero-var variables.\n")

num_participants = n_distinct(df_clean$num_id)

```


```{r check-cleaned-v1}
# Simulate what mlVAR does - check if lagging creates problems
df_clean %>%
  group_by(num_id) %>%
  arrange(num_id) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols), list(lag = ~lag(.)))) %>%
  summarise(across(ends_with("_lag"), function(x) sum(is.infinite(x) | is.nan(x), na.rm=TRUE))) %>%
  filter(if_any(-num_id, function(x) x > 0))


df_clean2 = df_clean %>% 
  count(num_id) %>% 
  filter(n <= 2) %>%
  arrange(n)

sapply(df_clean[, cols], function(x) range(x, na.rm=TRUE))


df_clean %>% 
  count(num_id) %>% 
  arrange(n) 

min_obs <- 40  # conservative cutoff

enough_obs_ids <- df_clean %>%
  count(num_id) %>%
  filter(n >= min_obs) %>%
  pull(num_id)

cat("Removing", n_distinct(df_clean$num_id) - length(enough_obs_ids), "participants with <", min_obs, "obs\n")

df_clean <- df_clean %>% filter(num_id %in% enough_obs_ids)
cat(n_distinct(df_clean$num_id), "participants remaining\n")

cat("For DF:", name, "STEP:", step, ":\n")

num_stayed_NONdep = n_distinct(df_clean[df_clean$stayed_depressed==1,]$num_id)
num_stayed_dep = n_distinct(df_clean[df_clean$stayed_depressed==2,]$num_id)

cat(num_stayed_NONdep, "non-depressed participants. ", num_stayed_dep, "depressed participants.\n")



```



```{r model}
clin <- mlVAR_GC(data = df_clean,  
                        vars = cols, 
                        idvar = "num_id", 
                        groups = "stayed_depressed", 
                        test = "permutation", 
                        paired = FALSE, 
                        contemporaneous = "orthogonal", 
                        temporal = "orthogonal", 
                        nP = 1000, nCores = 12, pbar = TRUE)



l_outlist <- list()
l_outlist$GC <- clin

saveRDS(l_outlist, file=file.path(brighten_dir, paste0("mnet_output_stayed_depressed_",model,"_",step, "_", name,".RDS")))

```

```{r groups}


clin_g1 <- mlVAR(data = df_clean[df_clean$stayed_depressed==1,],
                       vars = cols,
                       estimator = "lmer",
                       idvar = "num_id",
                       contemporaneous = "orthogonal",
                       temporal = "orthogonal")

l_outlist$g1 <- clin_g1


clin_g2 <- mlVAR(data = df_clean[df_clean$stayed_depressed==2,],
                       vars = cols,
                       estimator = "lmer",
                       idvar = "num_id",
                       contemporaneous = "orthogonal",
                       temporal = "orthogonal")

l_outlist$g2 <- clin_g2

saveRDS(l_outlist, file=file.path(brighten_dir, paste0("mnet_output_stayed_depressed_g1g2_",model,"_",name,".RDS")))


# Plot no-clinical-level at baseline
# P-values for the five parameter types:
pvalues = clin$Pval

# The observed group differences (i.e., the test statistics)
# Can be found in:
empdiff = clin$EmpDiffs

# Specifically, the difference is: group 1 - group 2
# For example:
groupdiff = clin$EmpDiffs$Phi_mean[1,2,]
# The true group difference was -0.4

library(qgraph)
# --- Check Results ---

output <- l_outlist$GC
out_g1 <- l_outlist$g1
out_g2 <- l_outlist$g2

# output$Runtime_min
# output$Pval$Lagged_fixed
#
# mean(output$Pval$Lagged_fixed<=0.05)
# sum(output$Pval$Lagged_fixed<=0.05)
#
# output$EmpDiffs

# For Tutorial
l_nets <- list()
l_nets$phi_group0 <- out_g1$results$Beta$mean[, , 1]
l_nets$phi_group1 <- out_g2$results$Beta$mean[, , 1]
l_nets$phi_diff <- output$EmpDiffs$Lagged_fixed[, , 1]
l_nets$phi_diffs_sig <- l_nets$phi_diff
l_nets$phi_diffs_sig[output$Pval$Lagged_fixed>0.05] <- 0

output$Pval$Lagged_fixed

titles <- c("Stayed Not-Depressed", "Stayed Depressed",
                  "Differences: Group Not-Depressed - Group Depressed",
                  "Significant Differences")

# --- Make Figure ---

pdf(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Figure_stayed_depressed2_mnet_",model,"_",step, "_", name,"_",num_participants,"p_.pdf")), width = 18, height = 14)

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

for(i in 1:4) qgraph(t(l_nets[[i]]),
                     layout = "circle",
                     edge.labels = TRUE,
                     title = titles[i],
                     theme = "colorblind",
                     maximum = 0.2,
                     mar = rep(8, 4),      # large mar gives room for long labels
                     labels = cols,  
                     label.scale = FALSE,
                     label.cex = 1,
                     vsize = 15,           # smaller nodes
                     esize = 10, 
                     asize = 8, 
                     label.prop = 1.5,    # pushes label outside the node boundary
                     edge.label.cex = 0.7,
                     edge.label.bg = TRUE,
                     label.norm = "OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO")  # reserves space for long labels

dev.off()
```
